svg.title: The believed evaluator precedes a long workstream sequence
svg.desc: Retain the belief half beside a provenance-bearing sequence of subsequent workstream thumbnails. The visual band recalls consequences without resolving the deployment dispute.

**Location:** `composite-accountability-forum`

**Frame:** The left half of the reproduction is lifted out on its own. Against it, a single continuous band of the book's own pages at thumbnail scale runs from the three folders of [page 010](010.md) panel 5 through the workstreams of [page 011](011.md) and does not stop until [page 072](072.md). Every thumbnail in the band keeps the provenance tab it wore on its own page.

**Action:** The reader is shown what the left-hand panel produced.

**Caption:**
> THE ESCALATION FROM PAGE 011 TO PAGE 072 PROCEEDS FROM THE LEFT-HAND PANEL.
>
> THE READER LAST SAW IT ON PAGE 010.

**Provenance:** `inferred` — the project's account of its own structure. The band is a claim about this book, not about the incident.
